identity.title: [v0.92.1][INT-02] Prepare release candidate rollback and ceremony

values.task_boundary: Implement only INT-02 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Exact release-candidate manifest and signed-off checklist.
Executed rollback rehearsal and operator ceremony runbook with abort evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Every release artifact, source revision, schema, evidence bundle, and external dependency is pinned.
Rollback is rehearsed from the candidate without data loss, dual authority, or hidden personal credentials.
Named company authority, observers, timing, abort triggers, communication, and post-release verification are recorded.
No release action occurs until the final operator authorization.
non_goals: Treating a written rollback plan as rehearsal
